in_marathi.name: Kanhaiyalal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Servant of Krishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanhaiyalal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Kanhaiyalal' is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name made up of 'Kanhaiya' and 'Lal'. 'Kanhaiya' means 'servant' or 'devotee' and 'Lal' means 'Krishna'. Therefore, the name 'Kanhaiyalal' signifies 'Servant of Krishna'. This name is popular in Hindu tradition and is often given to boys.
